changeinfo.changes: - Ensure sure proper access given to .net AND .com domain. - Updated google client id and settings. - Fixed a multiple chat and filter bugs and error messages. - Multiple text and brand usage updates. - Multiple updates to loading and handling SubmitDone calls.

FEATURES ADDED - Replay feature available on PS4. - New cards added. - Accounts have been reset. - AI behavior adjusted to favor self-preservation more highly. - Added targeting outlines on enemies within range of attacks to improve targeting clarity. - Movement Speed changes, increased projectile speed to match movement speed changes. - Surrender now available from the ingame menu. There is an initial cooldown period before you can initiate a surrender vote and a cooldown time between restarting the vote should the voting fail. - Card tooltip improvements added. - Networking changes for more stable communication between the client and the backend servers. - Added short combat messages explaining how buff orbs work when you pick them up. - Added death recap log. - Intro and respawn animations added. The player will spawn into the game playing an intro or respawn animation and will have their input blocked until that is finished. - Jungle camp initial spawn times reduced
BUGS FIXED - Many hitch and memory improvements, including server hitch duration on errors from 25 seconds to 1 second - Many crash bugs found and fixed - Fixed a crash on unexpected disconnect/logout while in team builder. - Players that have been removed from your friends list no longer remain in the quick invite option after they’ve been removed. - Fixed a crash that occurred while streaming textures. - Optimized triggering impact audio when doing damage to Heroes. - Added audio cue when pings are activated using the Team Comms. - Vision and Shadow Wards now support mini map ping system. - Fixed issue with hero bots sometimes choosing to not attack structures. - Fixed environment decals drawing on characters after being shielded. - Fixed shield effects lasting for lifetime of character when two shields were applied simultaneously. - Fix the bug that allowed people in shadow plane to still cast a shadow in the world. - Fixed issue where invites received while logging in would not show up on the UI. - Fixed bug preventing Card Shop correctly displaying Life Steal. - Fixed issue that allowed players to place ward while in base. - Fixes the bug where heroes models wouldn't go away when they died and would instead stay in the world awkwardly.
ALL HEROES - Added velocity-based landing effects for all Heroes. - Fixed a bug allowing you to emote while falling from a ledge. - Emoting as you take damage or are hit by a non-damaging ability (like a debuff) will now interrupt the animation. - Many Hero Specific design updates, see forum release notes for details.
UI UPDATES - Updated scoreboard layout. - Added ability to ping minimap from team comms. - Updated team comms menu options. - Misc bug fixes and UX improvements.
AI UPDATES - Bots will now use movement-related abilities when trying to run away (this includes Kallari entering shadow plane). - Bots will now upgrade their abilities in a specific order (used to be random) making sure to level up their Ult and LMB as soon as possible.

FEATURES ADDED - Replays are now available from the main menu - Store is now available from the main menu
GAMEPLAY UPDATES - Updated level progression for RMB and LMB - Damage updated for Casters / Mages - Removed ready check from matchmaking - We no longer gate players in groups on a ready check prompt before they can pick a hero in the play tab - Players can come and go from parties any time before the team lobby phase - Players are automatically unloaded when moving from the play tab - Heroes for players are reset when joining a new party for the first time to reduce collision chances with heroes - Slight tweaks to visuals for game type to make it more obvious that only the party leader can choose it. - When a team surrenders, the core explodes and ends like a normal match does.
AI UPDATES - At most, only 2 melee bots will be on your team or the enemy's team when running coop or solo vs. AI modes - Changed minion target selection to calculate hero timeouts per group/wave, now timeouts of one group will not affect other minions. - Improved Bots' ability selection so that they prefer abilities that already have target in range over the one that would require location adjustment - Improvements to Bots' movement abilities usage - Minions will ignore all hero targets and return to lane when dragged into jungle. - Minions will ignore hero target when dragged too far back on their lane. - Removing damage and status immunity from jungle camps due to proximity of hero will now affects all players from both teams, instead of just the ones being close. - Fixed a bug resulting in it being possible to have all bots fights on a single lane. - Fixed minion's hit reactions playing animation for wrong direction.
CARD UPDATES - Added Uncommon Movespeed cards: - (White affinity) Everglass: 2 Cooldown Reduction / ACTIVE- UNIQUE ACTIVE: On Ability Hit, +70 Move Speed - (Blue Affinity) Nanodrive: 1 Max Mana; 1 Energy Pen / ACTIVE- UNIQUE ACTIVE: 20 Move Speed for each nearby Hero (Max 80) 4s. - (Black Affinity) Sirensong: 1 Lifesteal / ACTIVE- UNIQUE ACTIVE: On Hit, 35 Steal Movespeed. - (Red Affinity) Heartshot: 1 Attack Speed / UNIQUE: On Kill Player, +70 Move Speed - Card - The Warlord, fixed spurious display of 2% damage value - Starter Deck Cleanup - Wards are Unique. Buying more doesn't grant extra charges. Reduced quantity of charges on ward cards. - Fixed an issue that would occasionally allow upgrades to be applied to maxed out cards
HERO UPDATES - Dekker & Twinblast can use their RMB while in shadowplane without being bumped out. - Gadget VisionBot: Added a decal to indicate the radius. - Gideon Teleport: Shrank the targeting cylinder width for his teleport, so he can squeeze it through tighter gaps / has less trouble aiming it accurately. - HyperBreach LRM: Fixed an edge case that could cause HB to fly. - Shortened respawn animations
UI UPDATES - Shop and Replay now available - Added a main volume slider to the Audio Settings menu. - Added icons to the death recap for the damage type (physical or energy) and replaced the ! for critical hits with a critical strike icon - Card points total added to scoreboard - Card Shop Updates - added undo, quick slotting, passive hotkeys - removed accept / decline, help text - Rewards appear as you level up now - should help clarify where rewards came from - Sources of XP and Reputation display as they are counted (full breakdown still available in the tooltip) - Minimap updated with new art - Social panel now shows when a player is currently watching a replay - Switched to circles and rings for Tower, Inhibitor, and Core health indicators on the minimap: should read better from far away. Switched player icon to be smaller, hopefully still readable. - Update chat fade, fonts, and text colors. Only team messages are displayed in white text. Other messages come out in the channel color - You can no longer bring up the scoreboard when the end game screen is up. - Fixed a bug that could prevent CXP meter from moving after recalling and spending card points. - Fixed a bug where a card pack bought couldn't be opened immediately if you previously had 0 packs - Fixed a bug where the confirmation screen would show "Error" for all confirmations once a single error had been shown. - Fixed a crash that can occur if the player selects a slot, clicks a card on top of the auto slot button. - Fixed an issue where bindings for secondary keys which are not bound by default wouldn't work correctly in game, or persist across sessions. - Fixed clipping issues in certain languages - Fixes to surrender UI - No longer running a bunch of code in widget renderer in a dedicated server to avoid a crash. - Stat bonuses unlocked by fully upgrading a card now appear on the card face when activated if they don't stack onto an existing card stat.
